description: This file serves as a web UI page for generating, displaying, printing, and downloading parental control reports. It integrates PHP for server-side includes, JavaScript for dynamic interactions (AJAX, DOM manipulation), and HTML for the structure. It manages report filters, dynamically presents report data in tables, and handles report type selection and time frame filtering.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch report data for the selected report type and time frame, then updates the UI tables accordingly.
